bridge-type.label: Dyson Account
bridge-type.description: A MyDyson cloud account, used to discover devices, obtain their credentials, connect through the Dyson cloud and manage firmware updates.

parameter.name: email
parameter.label: E-mail
parameter.description: E-mail address of the MyDyson account. In the China region a mobile number including the country code (e.g. +8613800000000) can be used instead.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Password of the MyDyson account. Not required for a mobile number login.

parameter.name: country
parameter.label: Country
parameter.description: Two letter country code of the account, e.g. US, GB, DE or CN.

parameter.name: culture
parameter.label: Culture
parameter.description: Language and country of the account, e.g. en-US, en-GB or de-DE.

parameter.name: otp
parameter.label: Verification Code
parameter.description: One-time verification code that Dyson sends by e-mail (or SMS) when the binding logs in. Enter it here to complete the login; it is cleared afterwards.

parameter.name: token
parameter.label: Token
parameter.description: Authentication token, filled in automatically after a successful login. Clear it to force a new login.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in minutes to refresh the device list and the firmware information.
